summary: Add an opt-in subject activity summary for runtime ownership readers, avoiding full claim provenance and harness history replay.

schema.detail: No storage or client-v0 schema or generated client changes.

compatibility.detail: subject show --activity-summary reads legacy /v1/status?activity_summary=true for an agent. The status envelope retains store_index and subject identity; actual contains only observed status, workspace and host. Full status remains the default.

manual.detail: Ownership consumers can opt into subject show SUBJECT --activity-summary --json --daemon-wait 0 after upgrading the daemon and CLI.

recovery.detail: Remove the opt-in flag to restore full inspection.
